clarity.notes: One conclusion, one blocker, and one primary next action define the first screen.

hierarchy.notes: Review, Claims, Verify, and Trace are task modes rather than competing dashboard widgets.

typography.notes: A restrained sans and mono dossier system provides clear evidence roles and locators.

motion.notes: Motion explains selection and graph changes and respects reduced motion.

brand.notes: The interface reads as a precision evidence dossier rather than a generic AI dashboard.

remaining_gaps: Mobile Claims uses an explicitly labeled, keyboard-focusable horizontal graph viewport. Navigation no longer overlays the graph and the page no longer overflows, but traversal of off-screen claim context still requires owner validation.
The synthetic fixed-position graph does not provide production-grade edge routing or collision avoidance.
Owner live review is still required before this prototype can support ticket closure.
